notes: No Genre: a cottagecore cottage in a forest of pastel flowers is a place and a mood, with the author confirming there is nothing to do but walk around and look — inventing a genre here would build a game nobody asked for. Explorable Place is the preset that matches an environment showcase, and its three options land cleanly: the cottage is the focal landmark, paths thread the forest so walking has a grain, and the pastel flower drifts are what the scenic vantage points are composed on. Every axis stays at its default, so this is a plain P0 — the author explicitly settled enclosure by saying the cottage is scenery only, which is what keeps P3 off a build that would otherwise have assumed an interior.
